title: Upon waking up
subtitle: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrecti
body: Upon waking up · Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr · All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection. · Immediately after waking, before getting out of bed. · Sahih al-Bukhari 6312 · Sahih al-Bukhari
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

title: Before sleep
subtitle: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
body: Before sleep · Bismika Allāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā · In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live. · Right before falling asleep. · Sahih al-Bukhari 6324 · Sahih al-Bukhari

title: Entering the home
subtitle: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our t
body: Entering the home · Bismillāhi walajnā, wa bismillāhi kharajnā, wa ʿalallāhi rabbinā tawakkalnā · In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our trust. · As you step into your home, before greeting the family. · Sunan Abu Dawud 5096 · Sunan Abu Dawud
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا

title: Leaving the home
subtitle: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
body: Leaving the home · Bismillāhi, tawakkaltu ʿalallāhi, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh · In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah. · Whenever you leave your home. · Sunan Abu Dawud 5095 · Sunan Abu Dawud
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

title: Before eating
subtitle: In the name of Allah.
body: Before eating · Bismillāh · In the name of Allah. · Before any meal or drink. If forgotten at the start: 'Bismillāhi awwalahu wa ākhirah.' · Sahih al-Bukhari 5376, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1858 · Sahih al-Bukhari

title: After eating
subtitle: All praise is for Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me, without any might or power on my pa
body: After eating · Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah · All praise is for Allah, who fed me this and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part. · After finishing any meal. · Sunan Abu Dawud 4023, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3458 · Sunan Abu Dawud
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ

title: For anxiety & grief
subtitle: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from stinginess
body: For anxiety & grief · Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa ḍalaʿid-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl · O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from stinginess and cowardice, from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men. · When you feel anxious, sad, or overwhelmed. · Sahih al-Bukhari 6369 · Sahih al-Bukhari
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

title: In distress
subtitle: There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty
body: In distress · Lā ilāha illallāhul-ʿaẓīmul-ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbul-ʿarshil-ʿaẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu rabbus-samāwāti wa rabbul-arḍi wa rabbul-ʿarshil-karīm · There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and of the earth and of the noble Throne. · In moments of serious distress or hardship. · Sahih al-Bukhari 6346, Sahih Muslim 2730 · Sahih al-Bukhari
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

title: The master of seeking forgiveness
subtitle: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep
body: The master of seeking forgiveness · Allāhumma anta rabbī, lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mastaṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abū'u laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abū'u bi-dhanbī, faghfir lī, fa innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant · O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me — for none forgives sins but You. · Morning and evening. Whoever says it with certainty in the morning and dies that day enters Paradise; likewise for the evening. · Sahih al-Bukhari 6306 · Sahih al-Bukhari
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

title: Short istighfar
subtitle: I seek forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance.
body: Short istighfar · Astaghfirullāha wa atūbu ilayh · I seek forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance. · Any time. The Prophet ﷺ said it more than seventy times a day. · Sahih al-Bukhari 6307 · Sahih al-Bukhari

title: For one's parents
subtitle: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
body: For one's parents · Rabbir-ḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā · My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small. · Frequently — a Quranic dua for one's parents, whether living or deceased. · Quran 17:24

title: For a righteous family
subtitle: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us a leade
body: For a righteous family · Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin waj-ʿalnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā · Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us a leader for the righteous. · For spouse, children, and future generations. · Quran 25:74
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

title: Morning & evening protection
subtitle: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm — He is the
body: Morning & evening protection · Bismillāhil-ladhī lā yaḍurru maʿasmihi shay'un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'i wa huwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm · In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm — He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. · Three times in the morning and three times in the evening. Nothing will harm you. · Sunan Abu Dawud 5088, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3388 · Sunan at-Tirmidhi
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

title: Against the evil eye and every harm
subtitle: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He has created.
body: Against the evil eye and every harm · Aʿūdhu bi-kalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq · I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He has created. · When stopping at any place, or entering somewhere unfamiliar — three times. · Sahih Muslim 2708 · Sahih Muslim
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

title: Good in this world and the next
subtitle: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment o
body: Good in this world and the next · Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāban-nār · Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. · One of the most frequent duas of the Prophet ﷺ — recite often, especially in tawaf. · Quran 2:201; Sahih al-Bukhari 6389
arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

title: The dua of Musa (Moses) — for ease
subtitle: My Lord, expand for me my chest, and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that th
body: The dua of Musa (Moses) — for ease · Rabbish-raḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī waḥlul ʿuqdatam-min lisānī yafqahū qawlī · My Lord, expand for me my chest, and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech. · Before any speaking task, difficult conversation, exam, or interview. · Quran 20:25-28
arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

title: Ayat al-Kursi (protection through the day)
subtitle: Allah — there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness over
body: Ayat al-Kursi (protection through the day) · Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm... · Allah — there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. · Whoever recites it after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents them from entering Paradise except death. · Quran 2:255; Sunan an-Nasa'i 9928
arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

title: After drinking water
subtitle: All praise is for Allah, who by His mercy made it sweet and pleasant, and did not make it salty and
body: After drinking water · Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī jaʿalahu ʿadhban furātan bi-raḥmatihi wa lam yajʿalhu milḥan ujājā · All praise is for Allah, who by His mercy made it sweet and pleasant, and did not make it salty and bitter. · After drinking water — remembering Allah's mercy in every sip. · Reported in works of adhkar based on Quran 25:53, 56:68-70 · Pending scholar review
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَهُ عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا
source: Reported in works of adhkar based on Quran 25:53, 56:68-70

title: When putting on clothes
subtitle: All praise is for Allah, who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, without any mi
body: When putting on clothes · Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī kasānī hādhath-thawba wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah · All praise is for Allah, who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, without any might or power on my part. · When putting on new or everyday clothing. · Sunan Abu Dawud 4023, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3458 · Sunan Abu Dawud
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ

title: Before entering the toilet
subtitle: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female evil beings.
body: Before entering the toilet · Bismillāh, Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabā'ith · In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female evil beings. · Before stepping into the bathroom or toilet — enter with the left foot. · Sahih al-Bukhari 142, Sahih Muslim 375 · Sahih al-Bukhari
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ

title: After leaving the toilet
subtitle: I seek Your forgiveness.
body: After leaving the toilet · Ghufrānak · I seek Your forgiveness. · Upon leaving the bathroom — exit with the right foot first. · Sunan Abu Dawud 30, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 7 · Sunan Abu Dawud

title: When feeling anger
subtitle: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shayṭān.
body: When feeling anger · Aʿūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm · I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shayṭān. · When you feel anger rising. Also: sit down if standing, lie down if sitting; perform wudu. · Sahih al-Bukhari 3282, Sahih Muslim 2610 · Sahih al-Bukhari

title: For relief from debt
subtitle: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and enrich me by
body: For relief from debt · Allāhummak-finī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmik, wa aghninī bi-faḍlika ʿamman siwāk · O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and enrich me by Your favour so that I have no need of anyone besides You. · When burdened by debt or financial pressure. Recite consistently. · Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3563 · Sunan at-Tirmidhi
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ

title: When afraid or facing an enemy
subtitle: O Allah, we place You before them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
body: When afraid or facing an enemy · Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim · O Allah, we place You before them, and we seek refuge in You from their evil. · When afraid of an enemy or facing a hostile situation. · Sunan Abu Dawud 1537 · Sunan Abu Dawud
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ

title: Ḥasbunallāh — Allah suffices us
subtitle: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
body: Ḥasbunallāh — Allah suffices us · Ḥasbunallāhu wa niʿmal-wakīl · Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. · When overwhelmed. Ibrahim (peace be upon him) said this in the fire; the Prophet ﷺ and his companions said it before Uḥud. · Quran 3:173; Sahih al-Bukhari 4563

title: Dua of Yunus (Jonah) — from the depths
subtitle: There is no god but You. Glory be to You — I have indeed been of the wrongdoers.
body: Dua of Yunus (Jonah) — from the depths · Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn · There is no god but You. Glory be to You — I have indeed been of the wrongdoers. · Any distress or difficulty. The Prophet ﷺ said no Muslim supplicates with this and is not answered. · Quran 21:87; Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505
arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

title: For increase in beneficial knowledge
subtitle: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
body: For increase in beneficial knowledge · Rabbi zidnī ʿilmā · My Lord, increase me in knowledge. · Before studying, before a lesson, before opening a book of knowledge. · Quran 20:114

title: For firmness and guidance
subtitle: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Ind
body: For firmness and guidance · Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā min ladunka raḥmah, innaka antal-wahhāb · Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower. · For firmness on the path, especially in times of fitnah (trial). · Quran 3:8
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ

title: Forgiveness for oneself, parents, and believers
subtitle: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.
body: Forgiveness for oneself, parents, and believers · Rabbanaghfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb · Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established. · In every dua for parents — including after obligatory prayers. · Quran 14:41
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ

title: For righteous offspring
subtitle: My Lord, grant me a righteous child.
body: For righteous offspring · Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn · My Lord, grant me a righteous child. · For those seeking children — as Ibrahim (peace be upon him) supplicated. · Quran 37:100

title: Before traveling (mounting a vehicle)
subtitle: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us — we could never have accomplished it ourselves — and i
body: Before traveling (mounting a vehicle) · Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā la-munqalibūn · Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us — we could never have accomplished it ourselves — and indeed, to our Lord we will return. · When boarding a car, plane, train, or any means of transport. · Sahih Muslim 1342; Quran 43:13-14
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ

title: Dua for Safar (travel) — full journey supplication
subtitle: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness, God-consciousness, and deeds pleasing
body: Dua for Safar (travel) — full journey supplication · Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādhā al-birra wat-taqwā, wa minal-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi ʿannā buʿdah. Allāhumma antaṣ-ṣāḥibu fis-safar, wal-khalīfatu fil-ahl. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthā'is-safar, wa ka'ābatil-manẓar, wa sū'il-munqalabi fil-māli wal-ahl · O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness, God-consciousness, and deeds pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up the distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a sorrowful sight, and from an evil turn of events in wealth and family. · Recite after settling onto your mount (car/plane/train) at the start of a journey — the Prophet ﷺ would say Allahu Akbar three times, then this dua. · Sahih Muslim 1342 · Sahih Muslim

body: Al-Malik The King, the Sovereign Every king answers to Him. His dominion has no beginning, no end, no rival.

title: Al-Quddus — The Most Holy
subtitle: Name 4 of 99
body: Al-Quddus The Most Holy Absolutely pure of every deficiency — no partner, no likeness, no need.

title: As-Salam — The Source of Peace
subtitle: Name 5 of 99
body: As-Salam The Source of Peace He is peace itself. To seek peace is to seek Him.

title: Al-Mu'min — The Guardian of Faith
subtitle: Name 6 of 99
body: Al-Mu'min The Guardian of Faith He safeguards those who trust in Him from ultimate loss.

title: Al-Muhaymin — The Overseer
subtitle: Name 7 of 99
body: Al-Muhaymin The Overseer Nothing escapes His witnessing — every atom, every intention, every whisper.

title: Al-Aziz — The Almighty
subtitle: Name 8 of 99
body: Al-Aziz The Almighty He cannot be overcome. His plans do not fail.

title: Al-Jabbar — The Compeller, the Restorer
subtitle: Name 9 of 99
body: Al-Jabbar The Compeller, the Restorer He mends what is broken — the shattered heart, the crushed spirit.

title: Al-Mutakabbir — The Supreme
subtitle: Name 10 of 99
body: Al-Mutakabbir The Supreme Greatness belongs to Him alone. All human pride is borrowed and fleeting.

title: Al-Khaliq — The Creator
subtitle: Name 11 of 99
body: Al-Khaliq The Creator He designs, forms, and gives being to everything from nothing.

title: Al-Bari — The Maker
subtitle: Name 12 of 99
body: Al-Bari The Maker He brings forth creation, precise and unrepeated.

title: Al-Musawwir — The Fashioner
subtitle: Name 13 of 99
body: Al-Musawwir The Fashioner Every face, every leaf pattern, every fingerprint bears His artistry.

title: Al-Ghaffar — The All-Forgiving
subtitle: Name 14 of 99
body: Al-Ghaffar The All-Forgiving Repeatedly forgiving, no matter how many times we return.

title: Al-Qahhar — The Subduer
subtitle: Name 15 of 99
body: Al-Qahhar The Subduer Every tyrant will one day stand before Him.

title: Al-Wahhab — The Bestower
subtitle: Name 16 of 99
body: Al-Wahhab The Bestower He gives without expectation, without exhaustion, without being asked.

title: Ar-Razzaq — The Provider
subtitle: Name 17 of 99
body: Ar-Razzaq The Provider Every creature's provision is written with Him — from the whale to the ant.

title: Al-Fattah — The Opener
subtitle: Name 18 of 99
body: Al-Fattah The Opener He opens doors no one can close — of understanding, provision, and mercy.

title: Al-Alim — The All-Knowing
subtitle: Name 19 of 99
body: Al-Alim The All-Knowing Not a leaf falls without His knowledge.

title: Al-Qabid — The Restrainer
subtitle: Name 20 of 99
body: Al-Qabid The Restrainer He withholds according to wisdom — sometimes the closed door is the mercy.

title: Al-Basit — The Expander
subtitle: Name 21 of 99
body: Al-Basit The Expander He opens up what was constrained — provision, heart, and horizon.

title: Al-Khafid — The Abaser
subtitle: Name 22 of 99
body: Al-Khafid The Abaser He humbles the arrogant, whatever throne they sit upon.

title: Ar-Rafi — The Exalter
subtitle: Name 23 of 99
body: Ar-Rafi The Exalter He raises the humble, the sincere, the servant nobody notices.

title: Al-Mu'izz — The Giver of Honor
subtitle: Name 24 of 99
body: Al-Mu'izz The Giver of Honor True honor comes only from His pleasure.

title: Al-Mudhill — The Humiliator
subtitle: Name 25 of 99
body: Al-Mudhill The Humiliator He humbles the tyrant in ways they never saw coming.

title: As-Sami — The All-Hearing
subtitle: Name 26 of 99
body: As-Sami The All-Hearing He hears the whisper of the ant on a black stone on a moonless night.

title: Al-Basir — The All-Seeing
subtitle: Name 27 of 99
body: Al-Basir The All-Seeing No moment of yours goes unseen — good or bad, alone or in a crowd.

title: Al-Hakam — The Judge
subtitle: Name 28 of 99
body: Al-Hakam The Judge His judgment is absolute justice — no bribe, no bias, no error.

title: Al-Adl — The Just
subtitle: Name 29 of 99
body: Al-Adl The Just Perfect justice — not one grain of wrong goes unaccounted.

title: Al-Latif — The Most Subtle
subtitle: Name 30 of 99
body: Al-Latif The Most Subtle He arranges affairs so gently and precisely that we often miss His hand in them.

title: Al-Khabir — The All-Aware
subtitle: Name 31 of 99
body: Al-Khabir The All-Aware He knows the depth of every situation — every motive behind every act.

title: Al-Halim — The Forbearing
subtitle: Name 32 of 99
body: Al-Halim The Forbearing He does not rush to punish. He gives time. He gives more time.

title: Al-Azim — The Magnificent
subtitle: Name 33 of 99
body: Al-Azim The Magnificent His majesty exceeds every attempt to describe or imagine.

title: Al-Ghafur — The Ever-Forgiving
subtitle: Name 34 of 99
body: Al-Ghafur The Ever-Forgiving His forgiveness covers what no eye has seen — including our secret sins.

title: Ash-Shakur — The Appreciative
subtitle: Name 35 of 99
body: Ash-Shakur The Appreciative He multiplies the reward for the smallest sincere deed.

title: Al-Aliy — The Most High
subtitle: Name 36 of 99
body: Al-Aliy The Most High Above all creation in essence, attributes, and status.

title: Al-Kabir — The Most Great
subtitle: Name 37 of 99
body: Al-Kabir The Most Great Everything else, however great we call it, is small before Him.

title: Al-Hafiz — The Preserver
subtitle: Name 38 of 99
body: Al-Hafiz The Preserver He guards the Quran, our deeds' record, and every atom of creation.

title: Al-Muqit — The Sustainer
subtitle: Name 39 of 99
body: Al-Muqit The Sustainer He measures out the sustenance of every soul, every meal, every breath.

title: Al-Hasib — The Reckoner
subtitle: Name 40 of 99
body: Al-Hasib The Reckoner Every deed will be weighed — nothing is too small to count.

title: Al-Jalil — The Majestic
subtitle: Name 41 of 99
body: Al-Jalil The Majestic Overwhelming in glory and grandeur.

title: Al-Karim — The Generous
subtitle: Name 42 of 99
body: Al-Karim The Generous He gives before being asked and forgives before being sought.

title: Ar-Raqib — The Watchful
subtitle: Name 43 of 99
body: Ar-Raqib The Watchful He watches over you when no one else does.

title: Al-Mujib — The Responsive
subtitle: Name 44 of 99
body: Al-Mujib The Responsive He answers every prayer — sometimes with yes, sometimes with better.

title: Al-Wasi — The All-Encompassing
subtitle: Name 45 of 99
body: Al-Wasi The All-Encompassing His mercy and knowledge encompass every corner of existence.

title: Al-Hakim — The All-Wise
subtitle: Name 46 of 99
body: Al-Hakim The All-Wise His wisdom is unseen but every event fits within it.

title: Al-Wadud — The Most Loving
subtitle: Name 47 of 99
body: Al-Wadud The Most Loving He loves those who turn to Him — a love that never withdraws.

title: Al-Majid — The Most Glorious
subtitle: Name 48 of 99
body: Al-Majid The Most Glorious His glory is intrinsic — not granted, not diminishable.

title: Al-Ba'ith — The Resurrector
subtitle: Name 49 of 99
body: Al-Ba'ith The Resurrector He will raise every soul from the earth — a return, not a beginning.

title: Ash-Shahid — The Witness
subtitle: Name 50 of 99
body: Ash-Shahid The Witness He witnesses every act you thought was private.

title: Al-Haqq — The Truth
subtitle: Name 51 of 99
body: Al-Haqq The Truth Everything else changes; He does not.

title: Al-Wakil — The Trustee
subtitle: Name 52 of 99
body: Al-Wakil The Trustee Hand your affairs to Him and He handles what you cannot.

title: Al-Qawiyy — The Most Strong
subtitle: Name 53 of 99
body: Al-Qawiyy The Most Strong Every strength you meet — your own, another's — is on loan from Him.

title: Al-Matin — The Firm, the Steadfast
subtitle: Name 54 of 99
body: Al-Matin The Firm, the Steadfast Absolute, unwavering, tireless.

title: Al-Waliyy — The Protecting Friend
subtitle: Name 55 of 99
body: Al-Waliyy The Protecting Friend He is closer to the believer than any friend can be.

title: Al-Hamid — The All-Praiseworthy
subtitle: Name 56 of 99
body: Al-Hamid The All-Praiseworthy He is praised in every language, every atom, whether we notice or not.

title: Al-Muhsi — The Accounter
subtitle: Name 57 of 99
body: Al-Muhsi The Accounter He counts every hair on every head, every drop in every ocean.

title: Al-Mubdi — The Originator
subtitle: Name 58 of 99
body: Al-Mubdi The Originator He begins every existence out of nothing.

title: Al-Mu'id — The Restorer
subtitle: Name 59 of 99
body: Al-Mu'id The Restorer He returns every soul to Him — a homecoming, not an ending.

title: Al-Muhyi — The Giver of Life
subtitle: Name 60 of 99
body: Al-Muhyi The Giver of Life He revived the dry earth with rain — He can revive any heart.

title: Al-Mumit — The Bringer of Death
subtitle: Name 61 of 99
body: Al-Mumit The Bringer of Death He measures the moment of every soul's departure with perfect wisdom.

title: Al-Hayy — The Ever-Living
subtitle: Name 62 of 99
body: Al-Hayy The Ever-Living His life is not sustained by anything else.

title: Al-Qayyum — The Self-Sustaining
subtitle: Name 63 of 99
body: Al-Qayyum The Self-Sustaining Every existence depends on Him; He depends on none.

title: Al-Wajid — The Finder
subtitle: Name 64 of 99
body: Al-Wajid The Finder He lacks nothing. Anything He wills, He has.

title: Al-Majid — The Glorious
subtitle: Name 65 of 99
body: Al-Majid The Glorious Noble in essence, generous in giving.

title: Al-Wahid — The One
subtitle: Name 66 of 99
body: Al-Wahid The One One in essence, in attributes, in worship deserved.

title: Al-Ahad — The Unique, the Only
subtitle: Name 67 of 99
body: Al-Ahad The Unique, the Only He has no partner, no equivalent, no image.

title: As-Samad — The Eternal Refuge
subtitle: Name 68 of 99
body: As-Samad The Eternal Refuge All creation depends on Him; He depends on nothing.

title: Al-Qadir — The All-Powerful
subtitle: Name 69 of 99
body: Al-Qadir The All-Powerful When He decrees a thing, He only says 'Be,' and it is.

title: Al-Muqtadir — The Omnipotent
subtitle: Name 70 of 99
body: Al-Muqtadir The Omnipotent His power is complete and always in place.

title: Al-Muqaddim — The Expediter
subtitle: Name 71 of 99
body: Al-Muqaddim The Expediter He advances whom He wills for reasons only He knows.

title: Al-Mu'akhkhir — The Delayer
subtitle: Name 72 of 99
body: Al-Mu'akhkhir The Delayer When your answer feels late, it may be perfectly on time.

title: Al-Awwal — The First
subtitle: Name 73 of 99
body: Al-Awwal The First Before all beginnings, Him.

title: Al-Akhir — The Last
subtitle: Name 74 of 99
body: Al-Akhir The Last After all endings, Him.

title: Az-Zahir — The Manifest
subtitle: Name 75 of 99
body: Az-Zahir The Manifest His signs are everywhere — for those who look.

title: Al-Batin — The Hidden
subtitle: Name 76 of 99
body: Al-Batin The Hidden Beyond every category, form, and perception.

title: Al-Wali — The Governor
subtitle: Name 77 of 99
body: Al-Wali The Governor He governs every event, no matter how chaotic it looks to us.

title: Al-Muta'ali — The Most Exalted
subtitle: Name 78 of 99
body: Al-Muta'ali The Most Exalted Beyond every high we can imagine.

title: Al-Barr — The Source of Goodness
subtitle: Name 79 of 99
body: Al-Barr The Source of Goodness Every good you meet flows from Him.

title: At-Tawwab — The Ever-Accepting of Repentance
subtitle: Name 80 of 99
body: At-Tawwab The Ever-Accepting of Repentance Every return is welcomed. The door does not close.

title: Al-Muntaqim — The Avenger
subtitle: Name 81 of 99
body: Al-Muntaqim The Avenger He rectifies wrongs, sometimes slowly, always fully.

title: Al-Afuww — The Pardoner
subtitle: Name 82 of 99
body: Al-Afuww The Pardoner He wipes the record clean — not just forgives, but erases.

title: Ar-Rauf — The Most Kind
subtitle: Name 83 of 99
body: Ar-Rauf The Most Kind Tender, gentle, patient with our fragility.

title: Malik-ul-Mulk — Owner of All Sovereignty
subtitle: Name 84 of 99
body: Malik-ul-Mulk Owner of All Sovereignty He gives kingdom to whom He wills, and takes it away.

title: Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram — Lord of Majesty and Honor
subtitle: Name 85 of 99
body: Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram Lord of Majesty and Honor Feared for His majesty, loved for His generosity.

title: Al-Muqsit — The Equitable
subtitle: Name 86 of 99
body: Al-Muqsit The Equitable He balances the scales that this world could never balance.

title: Al-Jami — The Gatherer
subtitle: Name 87 of 99
body: Al-Jami The Gatherer He will bring every soul back on the day of gathering.

title: Al-Ghaniyy — The Self-Sufficient
subtitle: Name 88 of 99
body: Al-Ghaniyy The Self-Sufficient He needs nothing from us; we need everything from Him.

title: Al-Mughni — The Enricher
subtitle: Name 89 of 99
body: Al-Mughni The Enricher He makes rich the poor and the heart of the poor rich.

title: Al-Mani — The Preventer
subtitle: Name 90 of 99
body: Al-Mani The Preventer He withholds what would harm us, even if we begged for it.

title: Ad-Darr — The Distresser
subtitle: Name 91 of 99
body: Ad-Darr The Distresser Sometimes hardship is the exact medicine we need.

title: An-Nafi — The Benefactor
subtitle: Name 92 of 99
body: An-Nafi The Benefactor Every benefit in your life came from Him — not luck, not skill.

title: An-Nur — The Light
subtitle: Name 93 of 99
body: An-Nur The Light The light of the heavens and the earth, and of every guided heart.

title: Al-Hadi — The Guide
subtitle: Name 94 of 99
body: Al-Hadi The Guide He guides whom He wills — ask Him for guidance daily.

title: Al-Badi — The Incomparable
subtitle: Name 95 of 99
body: Al-Badi The Incomparable His creation follows no pattern before it. Every galaxy is new to Him.

title: Al-Baqi — The Everlasting
subtitle: Name 96 of 99
body: Al-Baqi The Everlasting Everything perishes except His face.

title: Al-Warith — The Inheritor
subtitle: Name 97 of 99
body: Al-Warith The Inheritor All that we possess returns to Him.

title: Ar-Rashid — The Guide to the Right Path
subtitle: Name 98 of 99
body: Ar-Rashid The Guide to the Right Path He shows the way to those sincerely searching.

title: As-Sabur — The Most Patient
subtitle: Name 99 of 99
body: As-Sabur The Most Patient He is patient with our forgetfulness, our sins, our slow return.

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 1
subtitle: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to wh
body: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended. So whoever emigrated for worldly benefits or for a woman to marry, his emigration was for what he emigrated for.
arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 2
subtitle: Iman (belief) returns to Medina as a snake returns to its hole.
body: Iman (belief) returns to Medina as a snake returns to its hole.
arabic: أَنَّ الْإِيمَانَ لَيَأْرِزُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ كَمَا تَأْرِزُ الْحَيَّةُ إِلَى جُحْرِهَا

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 8
subtitle: Islam is based on five pillars: to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Mu
body: Islam is based on five pillars: to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, to offer the prayers dutifully and perfectly, to pay Zakat, to perform Hajj, and to fast during the month of Ramadan.
arabic: بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 13
subtitle: None of you will have faith till he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself.
body: None of you will have faith till he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself.
arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 39
subtitle: Religion is very easy and whoever overburdens himself in his religion will not be able to continue i
body: Religion is very easy and whoever overburdens himself in his religion will not be able to continue in that way. So you should not be extremists, but try to be near to perfection and receive the good tidings.
arabic: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا غَلَبَهُ

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 660
subtitle: Seven people will be shaded by Allah under His shade on the day when there will be no shade except H
body: Seven people will be shaded by Allah under His shade on the day when there will be no shade except His: a just ruler; a youth who grew up in the worship of Allah; a man whose heart is attached to the mosque; two people who love each other for Allah's sake; a man who is invited by a rich, beautiful woman and refuses, saying 'I fear Allah'; a man who gives in charity so secretly that his left hand doesn't know what his right hand has given; and a man who remembers Allah in solitude and his eyes are filled with tears.
arabic: سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّهُ: إِمَامٌ عَادِلٌ

title: muslim 8
subtitle: Islam is that you testify there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, that you
body: Islam is that you testify there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, that you establish the prayer, pay the zakat, fast the month of Ramadan, and make pilgrimage to the House if you are able. (The Hadith of Jibril — one of the most comprehensive hadiths in Islam.)
arabic: الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

title: muslim 55
subtitle: Religion is sincere advice. We asked: To whom? He said: To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leade
body: Religion is sincere advice. We asked: To whom? He said: To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims, and the common people.

title: muslim 2564
subtitle: He who has, in his heart, an ant's weight of arrogance will not enter Paradise.
body: He who has, in his heart, an ant's weight of arrogance will not enter Paradise.
arabic: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ

title: muslim 2699
subtitle: Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a bur
body: Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens of the Day of Judgment. Allah helps the servant so long as the servant helps his brother.
arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ

title: tirmidhi 2517
subtitle: Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
body: Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
arabic: دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ

title: tirmidhi 1987
subtitle: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with g
body: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with good conduct.
arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ

title: tirmidhi 2318
subtitle: Part of a person's excellence in Islam is his leaving alone that which does not concern him.
body: Part of a person's excellence in Islam is his leaving alone that which does not concern him.
arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ

title: abudawud 4682
subtitle: The most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character.
body: The most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character.

title: abudawud 4090
subtitle: The strong man is not the one who overcomes people by his strength, but the strong man is the one wh
body: The strong man is not the one who overcomes people by his strength, but the strong man is the one who controls himself when angry.
arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ

title: nasai 3140
subtitle: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.
body: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.

title: nasai 5442
subtitle: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not fea
body: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not fear (You), from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا

title: ibnmajah 224
subtitle: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
body: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
arabic: طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ

title: ibnmajah 4251
subtitle: The one who repents from a sin is like the one who has no sin.
body: The one who repents from a sin is like the one who has no sin.
arabic: التَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ كَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ

title: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018
subtitle: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
body: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ

title: Say SubhanAllah 100 times in the morning
body: Say SubhanAllah 100 times in the morning  Sunan an-Nasa'i 10629

title: Smile at your brother
body: Smile at your brother  Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1956

title: Istighfar 100 times a day
body: Istighfar 100 times a day  Sahih al-Bukhari 6307

title: Use the miswak
body: Use the miswak  Sahih al-Bukhari 887

title: Send salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
body: Send salawat on the Prophet ﷺ  Sahih Muslim 408

title: Sleep on your right side
body: Sleep on your right side  Sahih al-Bukhari 6314

title: Say Bismillah before eating
body: Say Bismillah before eating  Sahih al-Bukhari 5376

title: Pray Duha (mid-morning prayer)
body: Pray Duha (mid-morning prayer)  Sahih al-Bukhari 1178

title: Spread salaam widely
body: Spread salaam widely  Sahih al-Bukhari 12

title: Never miss Witr
body: Never miss Witr  Sunan Abu Dawud 1422
